name: Kyubin Park

organizations.name: Dept. of Smart Security, Gachon University

bio: I am an undergraduate researcher at the Information Security and Privacy Lab (ISPL), Department of Smart Security, Gachon University. I work on post-quantum and applied cryptography, and take part in a project on trustworthy agentic AI.

Cryptography is one of the few places in security where a guarantee can be proved rather than argued. What interests me — in the cryptography and the agentic AI work alike — is what survives the trip from that proof to a system people actually depend on, and I hope to keep working on that at a research institute such as ETRI.
